caption: The drawing depicts a single brown leather saddle shown in profile view against a plain, off-white background. The saddle has a high, rounded pommel and cantle, with decorative stitching along the seat and panels. Two yellow-gold eyelets with cream-colored leather ties can be seen on the back edge of the saddle. A wide leather stirrup strap runs down the center, and a single stirrup, which features a metal fixture and a brown leather tread, hangs downward to the bottom left. The saddle features several shades of brown, highlighting contours and the texture of the leather, and the hardware is rendered in a muted metal tone. The image is signed with the name “Harry Main Waddell” in small capital letters in the lower right corner. The background contains a few faint stains and marks, but is otherwise unadorned.
title: Saddle
